api.plan_resume(state, consumed_tokens=()): One-step review proposal. No Host, file IO, CLI, callable action or recovery execution.
api.reconstruct(preparation, inspection): Pure JSON-only state; invalid evidence raises Refusal; ambiguous or unsupported evidence remains blocked.
api.validate_proposal(proposal, preparation,: Pure stale/replay binding check; rechecks reconstruction and proposal identity.

blocked_cases: Any unknown or incomplete debug, signal, holder removal, install, plist or bootstrap outcome.
Every nonzero interactive sudo/debug result, including a claimed auth refusal: this Host has no reviewed pre-exec refusal protocol.
Any private-restore request/launch/start/exit/unresolved state; clean exit is not an outer witness. No relaunch.
All install, provider pin and bootstrap recovery phases, including apparently completed later phases.
Foreign/PID-reused processes, missing guards/held receipts, changed ownership/protected identities, inconsistent listeners or disk phases.
Stale proposals and caller-recorded consumed tokens.
inspector_03_delta: Separate apply_provider_restart/provider mapping; exact completion argv and plist hash.
Read-only fixed finite restore request/launch/start/exit/unresolved records, same transaction/request/backup/helper bindings; record absence retained.
No child process lookup, service probe, signal, write or retry. Original candidate02 inspector remains unchanged.
limitations: This is not full exact-phase recovery, a resume executor, an authorization or an enabled controller.
A proposal token is an identity, not an execution ledger; a future reviewed executor must durably claim it and enforce at-most-once action.
Retained inspector reports must be freshly revalidated before execution; the pure planner cannot establish current filesystem/process state.
Log-prefix continuity and real check-in/final snapshot/restore semantics are not requalified by reconstruction.
No guessed acknowledgement, state rollback, rearm, resignal, rebootstrap or forced termination.
Controller.run remains fresh-only. Production Host and controller remain disabled; no resume entrypoint exists.
reconstructed_values: original capture offsets/prefix identities and positive idle anchor
scope: Preparation only: finite retained-evidence reconstruction and nonexecuting proposals.

supported_checkpoints.both_parked: Both removals durably confirmed; source still original. Revalidate complete stopped inventory and backup only.
supported_checkpoints.provider_held: Durable exact provider holder plus unchanged original reservoir. Revalidate check-in; only with retained accepted check-in can propose verified-holder removal.
supported_checkpoints.reservoir_held: Provider durably parked with check-in; durable exact reservoir holder. Revalidate final snapshot, or propose holder removal after retained final witness.
